title: You think they won't care if you text… they'd be happier than you think 💬
caption:
You think they won't care if you text… they'd be happier than you think 💬 A study from the University of Pittsburgh: people who reached out to someone they had lost touch with underestimated how pleased the other person would be.

Who will you text tonight? Tell us in the comments 👇

slides.text: You think they won't care. Science disagrees.
Researchers in Pittsburgh had people message someone they'd lost touch with.
First, the senders guessed: how happy will the other person be?
Then the recipients were asked. They were happier than the senders guessed.
Experiment after experiment. The biggest surprise: messages out of the blue.
Your first sentence doesn't have to fix anything. “I've been thinking about you.”
